datasets.name: Landslide inventory from multi-temporal digital aerial-photo interpretation (2005–2006)
datasets.verbatim: Based on a previous work [26], a landslide inventory from multi-temporal digital aerial-photo interpretation (2005–2006) is being used for the delimitation of the area in exam and for the validation of the classification method.

datasets.name: Terra-ASTER L2 products
datasets.verbatim: The data used for this work were Terra-ASTER L2 products.

datasets.name: Nationwide 10 m resolution ALS DTM
datasets.verbatim: Two available DTMs (Digital Terrain Models) based on Airborne Laser Scanning (ALS) were used for the flat terrain correction: a nationwide 10 m resolution ALS DTM

datasets.name: Local ALS DTM Vorarlberg
datasets.verbatim: Two available DTMs (Digital Terrain Models) based on Airborne Laser Scanning (ALS) were used for the flat terrain correction: ... a local ALS DTM Vorarlberg (for the core study area only) with 1-m resolution.

datasets.name: Building shape file for the Open Street Map Project
datasets.verbatim: by using the publicly available building shape file for the Open Street Map Project [35] a correction of the artefacts present into the derived DTM slope model was performed.

methods.name: Double classification workflow (supervised followed by unsupervised)
methods.summary: A semi-automatic image classification workflow consisting of two steps: 1) a supervised classification using a maximum likelihood classifier with three spectral change indices, and 2) an unsupervised classification using another set of three spectral change indices, combined to identify landslide-induced vegetation change.
methods.verbatim: the landslide detection method, which adopted an innovative double classification workflow (a first supervised followed by an unsupervised algorithm)... The entire procedure, illustrated in Figure 7 and computed in ArcGIS, can be subdivided in the following sub-steps: 1. Image pre-processing; 2. Image processing; 3. Image post-processing.

availability.author_statement: The data presented in this study are available on request from the corresponding author. The data are not publicly available because not yet being included completely in our landslide geo-database.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory and other input datasets are mentioned but not linked or made available, and the custom classification code is not provided.
